config.sampler: independent sequential TPE, 4 startup trials, no pruning
config.feature_window: last N matches, integer2-12; not number of seasons
config.holdout: Final20% with whole kickoff groups; fixed fitted model, advancing pre-match history
config.selection: Development-only expanding-window log loss; same attempted trial budget for model-only and joint

results.holdout_protocol: Fixed model; pre-match features advance after earlier kickoff results. Earlier kickoff does not prove final-whistle or source-arrival availability.
results.feature_semantics: window counts the last N matches, not N seasons; elo_k is update magnitude; home_advantage offsets the Elo expectation, not a probability.

limits: Historical2022/23-2024/25 snapshots fetched2026-10-08 have been used in earlier research; no fresh unseen or prospective claim.
Three fixed seeds and12attempts per search; a small budget in unequal-dimensional spaces, not a general optimizer ranking.
Window means last N matches, not training-season length. No goal-margin Elo multiplier, player-rating model or ordered-logit reproduction.
All candidates retain the existing cold-start1500 and no seasonal rating reset; tuning does not establish promoted-team calibration.
Models fixed within the holdout; historical earlier-kickoff outcomes advance features. Earlier kickoff is not proof of final-whistle/source-arrival availability.
Feature recipe is research-only; no production bundle, live forecast, source snapshot or main database changes.

optuna.scope: Official mixed integer/log-scaled spaces, dimensionality warning and sequential seeded reproducibility; use existing independent TPE.

related_rating_supplement.scope: Selected A.1 team-rating text, physical PDF pages2-3 only. Reviewed update parameters, initialization and home-advantage handling; local recipe retains its existing cold start and expectation offset. No margin multiplier, warm-up performance ratings, player ratings or original ordered-logit reproduction.

source7_original_paper.scope: Official publisher search-preview metadata/abstract/introduction only; direct full text403. Not counted as a selected-method implementation.

numeric.scope: Independent raw-score rating/form/rest replay plus NumPy metrics and fresh best-config fold fits; historical snapshots only, no main DB.

cli.mode: Actual offline research CLI; PL2022/23-2024/25, GaussianNB/genetic,4trials

independent_review.status: Passed after fixing aggregate error privacy; no unresolved findings.
independent_review.scope: Scoped source diff, two consolidated cases and one tiny synthetic privacy reproducer; no duplicate full suite, real study or main DB access.

verification.prose: Chinese humanizer-zh and English stop-slop. Offline Harper found7 suggestions in the added English section; reviewed and retained technical stderr, Elo/Optuna names, authors and A.1 section label.
